TestTimeWindowCompactionStrategyAddition.description: Single node (--smp 1, compaction=debug), TWCS table with 1-minute windows and expired_sstable_check_frequency_seconds=0, tombstone_gc immediate. With autocompaction disabled, writes ~3 min of backdated data with TTL=30s and flushes every 30s (several sstables), then starts a 4-min (12 in debug) cassandra-stress write load (300 threads, 30 in debug), waits TTL+grace, enables autocompaction and asserts the created sstables are removed from disk within the timeout. Then parses system.log: every compaction that includes an sstable logged as 'Fully expired sstable' must end with 'sstables to []', i.e. expired sstables are compacted in their own expired-only job and not mixed with live ones. Guards scylladb#9533 (expired TWCS sstables not evicted under heavy load), fixed by 79b0654d60 (separate has_only_fully_expired compaction descriptor).

TestTimeWindowCompactionStrategyAddition.reason: Unique coverage of scylladb#9533 (TWCS compacts fully expired sstables in a separate expired-only job and evicts them promptly under write load); no scylla unit test checks has_only_fully_expired descriptors. Stable (32/32), ~76s, next_gating. Note: twcs_additional_test.py:162-165 asserts 'sstables to []' only for expired-sstable compactions whose 'Compacted' end line is already in the log; in-flight ones (stress data also has TTL) are silently skipped, but compactions of the backdated sstables must have finished (eviction assert :46), so the #9533 mixing check still covers them. Fix: assert every entry in `compactions` has an end line. Notes: wait_until_sstables_are_evicted (:120) logs 'sstables has been removed' even on timeout (cosmetic; :46 asserts the result); c-s container capped at 1 CPU since 47dbad38, so load is weaker than the #9533 repro.
